definitions: A sudden but brief success or phenomenon that is not repeated or does not lead to lasting success.
Someone or something that shows great promise but ultimately fails to deliver or maintain that promise.
examples: His first album was a hit, but his subsequent work proved he was just a flash in the pan.
Many critics dismissed the new technology as a flash in the pan, but it revolutionized the industry.
The team's early winning streak turned out to be a flash in the pan as they finished last.
